description: Generate a STANDALONE <es-table> component — a self-contained .vue SFC (columns + options + data-source/pagination refs) that drops next to native/third-party components. Give apiUrl for auto-fetch via es-table's apiParams. Use this ONLY when the user explicitly wants a single table on its own. For a full CRUD page (query + table + add/edit/delete) use generate_scene (scene='crud') instead. Operation-column buttons emit a `row-action` event (`{ key, row }`) from an inlined clickEvent, so the fragment always compiles in isolation — this is not the CRUD page's `triggerEvent` (query/reset toolbar linking). This entry accepts the same table vocabulary as the CRUD front door: explicit `columns` (multi-level group headers / index-selection-expand columns), top-level `treeConfig` (cross-renderer nested tree), top-level `expandConfig` (declarative expanded content), `mergeConfig` (adjacent-row merge) and `rowkey` — all emitted with the same contract as the CRUD page. `tableOptions.treeConfig` / `tableOptions.expandConfig` remain the vxe-only rich variants. The only table-surface key NOT accepted here is `tableBtns` (toolbar buttons with code:1/2 positioning live in the CRUD page schema) — use generate_scene with scene='crud' for it.

tagType.description: Render this option as a tag in the TABLE cell, in this semantic colour. Ignored by the form controls.

var.description: Model field path to read, e.g. "status" or "user.type"

autoFilters.description: Derive `filters` from this column's `dataOptions` (P2-3). When true and `filters` is omitted, each `dataOptions` entry's label/value becomes a filter option ({text, value}). Explicit `filters` always wins; no-op when dataOptions is empty or the engine is vue3 virtual (no filter UI).

editRender.description: Column-level inline editor (AI-09 子项④). vxe engine only — requires tableOptions.editConfig AND tableOptions.engine:'vxe'. Function-valued fields (events) and custom-registered renderers are out of scope (Tier-3).

name.description: Inline-edit renderer name, e.g. '$input' | '$select' | '$textarea' | '$date' (vxe engine only).

options.description: Option list for a '$select' editor (label/value pairs).

props.description: Props forwarded to the editor component.

type.description: 'default' = enter edit on trigger; 'visible' = editor always shown.

expandConfig.description: Row-expand content declared ON the `type:'expand'` column (AI-09 子项②). Same shape/semantics as the top-level `expandConfig`; use it when the expander is not the leading column or when `columns` is the source of truth. If BOTH are set, the top-level one wins on the expand column. Distinct from `tableOptions.expandConfig` (the vxe `{accordion}` switch).

fields.description: Read-only fields rendered inside the expanded row, one per line as `label: value`.

labelKey.description: i18n label key (used with a global t() function; takes precedence over `label`).

title.description: Optional title shown at the top of the expanded row.

filterMode.description: Local comparison for `filters` (default 'equals'): 'equals' = value equality (booleans/numbers compare loosely against strings), 'includes' = the cell text CONTAINS the selected option value (text search).

filterMultiple.description: Allow selecting several filter options at once (default true).

filters.description: Declarative column filter options (PLAIN JSON — never a JS function). Rendered by the default engines and engine:'vxe'; the virtual engine (vue3 engine:'virtual') has NO filter UI. Filtering is LOCAL (the wrapper filters rows in the browser), so do not combine it with server-side paging/proxy contracts for the same column.

text.description: Option text shown in the filter dropdown.

value.description: Row value matched by this option (loose primitive compare: 1 matches "1").

groups.description: Nested child columns for a GROUP HEADER (multi-level). Recursive. Cross-renderer safe up to 2 levels (antdv supports N; vue3/vue2 default tables flatten beyond 1).

label.description: Column header text. Omit for non-field columns.

labelKey.description: i18n key alternative to label (used when i18n is on)

permissionValue.description: Permission code; the column is not rendered without it

prop.description: Data key for this column, e.g. "userName". Omit for non-field columns (type: index/selection/expand).

type.description: Non-field column kind: 'index' = row number, 'selection' = checkbox column, 'expand' = row expander (needs an expandConfig/slot). Omit for a normal data column.

apiUrl.description: REST endpoint for the list. If set, the table auto-fetches via apiParams; if omitted, wire tableData manually.

columns.description: Explicit table columns — the SAME vocabulary as generate_crud's `columns` (override, not merge): multi-level group headers via `groups`, and non-field columns via `type` (index/selection/expand). When present it REPLACES the field-derived data columns (`fields` stays required and still documents the row shape). Contract keys are sanitized exactly like the CRUD page (unknown keys dropped, `x-*` kept).

expandConfig.description: Declarative row-expand content — the SAME shape as generate_crud's top-level `expandConfig` ({title?, fields[]}). Prepends one expand column showing a read-only field list; if `columns` already has a {type:'expand'} column, the content attaches to it. Distinct from the vxe-only `tableOptions.expandConfig`.

fields.description: Read-only fields rendered inside the expanded row, one per line as `label: value`.

labelKey.description: i18n label key (used with a global t() function; takes precedence over `label`).

title.description: Optional title shown at the top of the expanded row.

fields.description: Table columns — one per column the user described

apiParams.description: Remote options source for Select/Cascader/TreeSelect — use instead of dataOptions when options come from an API.

attrs.description: Extra component props, e.g. { type: 'textarea', maxlength: 200 }

dataOptions.description: Static options for Select/Radio/Checkbox/Cascader/TreeSelect/Autocomplete. Use this for known fixed enums.

filters.description: Filter options (plain JSON, never a function). On a FIELD they project onto the derived column. Local filtering on the default/vxe engines only — vue3 engine:'virtual' has no filter UI.

text.description: Option text shown in the filter dropdown.

value.description: Row value matched by this option (loose primitive compare: 1 matches "1").

formSpan.description: Grid width of this field in the add/edit form (1-24; 2 columns = 12 each). Column count is set PER FIELD — `formLayout` has no span key.

formatter.description: Extension point: JS arrow-function source for read-only cell formatting, e.g. "(row) => row.amount.toFixed(2)".

formtype.description: Pick by MEANING, not keywords: status/type/enum/gender → Select; date/time → DatePicker/TimePicker; image/avatar/attachment/file → Upload; long text/remark/description → Input (attrs.type:'textarea'); boolean on/off → Switch; single-choice small set → Radio; multi-choice → Checkbox; region/category tree → Cascader; department/org/permission tree with ANY level selectable → TreeSelect; type-to-filter over a known option set → Autocomplete; score → Rate; plain text → Input. OMIT only for a nested-object container (a field carrying `children`) — it renders no input.

group.description: Form-group key for the FORM face. Fields sharing a key are rendered inside that group's container; declare the containers in `formLayout.layout` (query form) or `dialogs[k].formLayout.layout` (dialog form). Ignored by the table column. Omit to follow the layout's `ungrouped` strategy.

field.description: Model field path to test, e.g. "status" or "user.type"

op.description: Operator: eq/ne = equal/not-equal (default eq; number↔string tolerated, e.g. 1 matches '1'); in/nIn = in/not-in the given array; empty/notEmpty = ''/null/undefined/[]; truthy/falsy = JS truthiness. The field is hidden WHEN it holds.

value.description: Right-hand side of the comparison. REQUIRED for eq/ne (scalar) and in/nIn (array). IGNORED by empty/notEmpty/truthy/falsy.

var.description: Model field path to read, e.g. "status" or "user.type"

field.description: Model field path to test, e.g. "status" or "user.type"

op.description: Operator: eq/ne = equal/not-equal (default eq; number↔string tolerated, e.g. 1 matches '1'); in/nIn = in/not-in the given array; empty/notEmpty = ''/null/undefined/[]; truthy/falsy = JS truthiness. The field is hidden WHEN it holds.

value.description: Right-hand side of the comparison. REQUIRED for eq/ne (scalar) and in/nIn (array). IGNORED by empty/notEmpty/truthy/falsy.

var.description: Model field path to read, e.g. "status" or "user.type"

isHidden.description: Hidden when the condition HOLDS — PLAIN JSON DATA, never a JS function string (functions cannot be inlined into a schema-mode pageSchema). `{ field: 'payType', op: 'eq', value: 'cash' }` = hidden while payType is cash; an ARRAY of conditions is AND. TWO forms, never mixed within one node: (1) legacy `{ field, op, value }` with op ∈ eq|ne|in|nIn|empty|notEmpty|truthy|falsy (default eq) — preferred for simple comparisons; (2) a JSONLogic-shaped expression when a plain condition can't express it (OR, ordering, nesting): `{ or: [ { '==': [{ var: 'status' }, 'pending'] }, { '>': [{ var: 'amount' }, 100] } ] }`; expression ops (closed set): var == != > >= < <= in nin empty notEmpty truthy falsy and or not if. A form-(2) op inside a form-(1) node is INVALID (runtime warns and treats the field as visible). Applies to the query/filter and add/edit dialog forms (its `inQuery`/`inForm` placement) — NOT to the table column (`inTable`). Evaluated live by the three renderers.

labelKey.description: i18n key for this field's label (instead of `label`; derived as `field.<prop>` when omitted). Only takes effect once the HOST assembles the plugin with a `t` option (else falls back to `label`).

permissionValue.description: Permission CODE gating this field (RBAC, checked by the host's global permission(code)) — NOT a data-driven condition: use `isHidden` for show/hide by another field's value, `reactions` for options/required/disabled linkage.

prop.description: Field key in the data model (camelCase), e.g. "userName"

querySpan.description: Grid width of this field in the query form (1-24; 2 columns = 12 each). Column count is set PER FIELD — `formLayout` has no span key.

reactions.description: Field-level linkage / computed rules (AI-07) — PLAIN JSON, never JS callbacks. Use when THIS field's options/required/disabled/value depend on ANOTHER field. Each rule `{ dependencies?, when?, fulfill }`: `dependencies` = model paths that re-trigger it (REQUIRED when `fulfill.value` is set); `when` gates the rule; `fulfill` supplies `dataOptions` (literal array), `required`/`disabled` (boolean expressions) and/or `value` (this field's new value, written back). `when`/`required`/`disabled`/`value` are JSONLogic EXPRESSION NODES only (e.g. `{ '==': [{ var: 'country' }, 'us'] }`) — never the `{ field, op, value }` legacy form, never a bare boolean. Example: `city` options follow `province` → one rule per province with `when: { '==': [{ var: 'province' }, 'zj'] }` and `fulfill.dataOptions: [{label:'杭州',value:'hz'}]`. Applies to the query/add/edit forms — NOT the table column. HARD RULE: branching on a dropdown LABEL ('跨境结算') requires that field's `dataOptions` and comparing the VALUE ('cross') — rows carry codes, not labels; `validate_config` warns (non-blocking).

dependencies.description: Model paths that trigger re-evaluation of this rule. REQUIRED when `fulfill.value` is present.

dataOptions.description: Literal option array for this field when the rule is active (NOT an expression — the DSL forbids object literals, so branch by declaring one rule per case with its own `when`).

var.description: Model field path to read, e.g. "status" or "user.type"

disabled.description: Expression node evaluating to a boolean: disable this field.

var.description: Model field path to read, e.g. "status" or "user.type"

required.description: Expression node evaluating to a boolean: make this field required.

var.description: Model field path to read, e.g. "status" or "user.type"

value.description: Expression node evaluating to this field's new value, written back to the model (requires a non-empty `dependencies`).

var.description: Model field path to read, e.g. "status" or "user.type"

when.description: Optional gate: the rule applies only while it evaluates truthy. A JSONLogic EXPRESSION NODE (e.g. { "==": [{ var: "country" }, "us"] }) — never the { field, op, value } legacy form (that one belongs to isHidden), never a bare boolean. Plain JSON, never a JS function string.

render.description: Extension point: a render-function source string for a custom TABLE CELL, e.g. "(_, { row }) => h(ElTag, { type: row.status === 1 ? 'success' : 'danger' }, () => row.statusLabel)" (wired to a scoped slot). A FORM-control render cannot be inlined (form items are serialized as JSON data), so it is preserved as a marked TODO(es-plus) marker in the SFC — NOT silently delivered; prefer the declarative rules/attrs/dataOptions/reactions for FORM behaviour.

rules.description: Validation rules for this field. Use `pattern`/`min`/`max`/`type` for format constraints and `trigger` for when validation runs; `message` is REQUIRED. CONFIG-side (artifact: `formItemOptions.rules`). A rule carrying `type` is dispatched ONLY to that type validator (async-validator `getValidationMethod`) — a `pattern` on the SAME rule is silently ignored, so when the user states BOTH a regex and a type, emit them as TWO separate rules. For a plain text length cap (e.g. '最多 20 字') prefer `attrs.maxlength`; a `min`/`max` rule validates values with a message but does not block typing. Emit these rather than dropping a format/range requirement the user stated.

max.description: Maximum length for strings / maximum value for numbers.

message.description: Message shown when the rule fails — REQUIRED, write it in the user's language.

min.description: Minimum length for strings / minimum value for numbers.

pattern.description: RegExp SOURCE STRING the value must match (e.g. "^1\d{10}$"), not a RegExp object.

required.description: Enforce a value with this rule (same effect as field-level `required`; prefer the field-level key for unconditional requirements).

trigger.description: 'blur' validates when the field loses focus; 'change' validates while the value changes.

type.description: Value type validated by this rule.

mergeConfig.description: Declarative row-merge ({rowsBy: ['dept','team']}) — the SAME cross-renderer narrow subset as generate_crud's top-level `mergeConfig`. Emitted as `options.mergeConfig`; el-table / a-table / vxe all honor it.

rowsBy.description: Column props to merge. Each is grouped by ADJACENT-EQUAL values: the first row of a run keeps the cell with rowspan = run length, the rest are merged away.

pagination.description: Pagination seed ({pageSize, pageSizes}); current/total are managed by the component.

pageSize.description: Rows per page on first render (default 10).

pageSizes.description: Selectable page-size options shown in the pager, e.g. [10, 20, 50].

rowButtons.description: Optional operation-column buttons. Each button emits a `row-action` event (`{ key, row }`) from an inlined clickEvent and the wrapper declares `emits: ['row-action']` — the host listens on the wrapper. This is NOT the CRUD page's `triggerEvent` (that only links query/reset toolbar buttons to table refresh).

rowkey.description: Primary key. Same as tableOptions.rowkey; when both are set this top-level key wins (with a warning).

tableOptions.description: Container options — the SAME declarative subset as generate_crud's tableOptions (core TableOptions minus function values): appearance (border/stripe/size/showHeader/emptyText/leftText), height (heightType/tabHeight/height), columns (multiSelect/snIndex), state (cachePageSelection), row (rowkey/rowClassName/defaultSort), request (refetchKeepPage/localPagination/configTableOut), engine (virtual/engine/rowHeight/estimatedRowHeight/overscanCount), tree (treeConfig — vxe rich tree), row expand (expandConfig — vxe switch), inline edit (editConfig — requires engine:'vxe').

cachePageSelection.description: Persist the checkbox selection across page changes (needs a stable rowkey). Default true at runtime; set false to reset selection on page change.

columnConfig.description: vxe column config, e.g. { resizable: true, drag: true, showOverflow: 'tooltip' }. Advanced: only with engine:'vxe'.

configTableOut.description: Map the LIST API response onto table semantics when the backend does not use the default flat shape. Default mapping is { total: "records", tableData: "rows", pageSize: "pageSize", current: "pageNo" }. Each value is the FLAT response key (no deep paths — the component only reads top-level keys). e.g. a backend returning { list: [...], count: N } → { tableData: "list", total: "count" }. Only the keys you set are remapped; omit a key to keep its default.

defaultSort.description: Default sort applied on first render.

editConfig.description: Enable vxe inline editing (AI-09 子项④). vxe engine only — MUST be paired with tableOptions.engine:'vxe'. A cell is only editable when its column also declares `editRender`. An edit writes STRAIGHT into the row object of `:data-source` (the table holds the same row references, so the host also gets `update:dataSource`); `keepSource` is auto-enabled only to keep a snapshot for `revertData()`, it is NOT a private copy. To learn WHICH cell changed and what the previous value was, listen to the `cell-edit` event — `{ row, prop, value, oldValue }`, emitted on blur / row switch in cell mode (one per changed cell in row mode), never for an unchanged cell.

emptyText.description: Text shown when there are no rows (default '暂无数据').

engine.description: Table rendering engine, an alternative to `virtual: true`. 'default' = el-table / a-table / el-table. 'virtual' = vue3 el-table-v2 only; antdv and vue2 have no virtual engine and degrade to a plain table with a warning. 'vxe' = vxe-table, available on ALL THREE targets — vue3 and antdv through their own vxe adapters, and vue2 through @es-plus/vue2's vxe engine. Use 'vxe' for large data on antdv/vue2, where 'virtual' is not available.

estimatedRowHeight.description: Estimated row height for dynamic-height virtual scrolling (vue3 / el-table-v2 only)

expandConfig.description: vxe-only row-expand switch (paired with `expand: true` / an expand column). Distinct from the top-level `expandConfig` (declarative read-only field list honored by all three renderers).

accordion.description: Accordion mode: at most one row expanded at a time.

lazy.description: Lazy-load expand content (vxe only; the loader function itself is a Tier-3 extension point).

exportConfig.description: vxe export config: `true` for defaults, or an object with filename / type ('xlsx'|'csv'|'html'|'xml'|'txt') / useStyle / isColgroup. Advanced: only with engine:'vxe'. Non-CSV formats need the vxe export plugin; the `download` callback is a function and is out of the JSON contract.

footerData.description: Static footer rows, a 2-D array ([row][column]). Advanced: only with engine:'vxe'. The function form `footerMethod` cannot travel in JSON — use `vxeConfig` at runtime.

height.description: Container height used ONLY when heightType is 'height' (ignored for 'auto' / 'maxHeight' — use tabHeight there). Takes precedence over nothing: an explicit tabHeight always wins.

heightType.description: How the container height is applied: 'height' = fixed height (value from `height`, or `tabHeight` if set); 'maxHeight' = capped at `tabHeight` (a `height` value is IGNORED); 'auto' = no container height constraint. Default 'auto'.

keepSource.description: Keep a pre-edit snapshot of each row so revertData() / getUpdateRecords() / getInsertRecords() work. Auto-enabled when editConfig is set. Advanced: vxe inline editing only.

keyboardConfig.description: vxe keyboard navigation. Advanced: only consumed with engine:'vxe', typically together with editConfig.

isArrow.description: Arrow keys move the cell focus.

isEdit.description: Any printable character enters edit mode.

isTab.description: Tab moves to the next cell.

leftText.description: Text shown on the left side of the table toolbar.

localPagination.description: Paginate already-fetched data client-side instead of requesting each page from the API.

mouseConfig.description: vxe cell-selection mode (`{ selected: true }` enables click-to-select). Advanced: only with engine:'vxe'.

selected.description: Click a cell to highlight/select it (arrow keys then move it).

overscanCount.description: Buffer rows outside the visible area (vue3 / el-table-v2 only; default 2)

printConfig.description: vxe print config: `true` for defaults, or e.g. { columns: [{ field: 'name' }] }. Advanced: only with engine:'vxe'.

refetchKeepPage.description: Keep the current page when re-fetching (default false). Query/reset still return to page 1.

rowHeight.description: Row height in px for virtual mode (vue3 / el-table-v2 only; default 50)

seqConfig.description: vxe sequence-column config (needs `snIndex: true` or a type:'index' column). Only `startIndex` is JSON-safe — `seqMethod` is a function and stays in the runtime escape hatch. Advanced: only with engine:'vxe'.

showFooter.description: Show the vxe footer row. Advanced: only consumed with engine:'vxe'.

showHeader.description: Show the table header (default true). Set false to hide it.

size.description: Table density. Default 'small' at runtime; el-table and a-table both accept these.

snIndex.description: Render a leading row-index (serial number) column.

sortParam.description: Server-side sorting: when set, the table stops sorting the current page locally and every list request carries { sortField, sortOrder } (order = 'asc' | 'desc'); a header click refetches the SAME page. { field, order } renames the two request keys. Also seeds from defaultSort, so the first request is already sorted. Omit to keep client-side sorting of the current page.

tabHeight.description: Table height consumed for EVERY heightType: under 'height' it overrides `height`; under 'maxHeight' it is the cap. number → px, string → raw CSS value (e.g. '60vh'). Prefer it over `height` whenever a concrete height is needed — it is the only height key that applies when heightType is 'maxHeight'.

toolbarConfig.description: vxe toolbar config (`true` for defaults, or { buttons: [...] } etc.). Advanced: only with engine:'vxe'.

treeConfig.description: vxe-only rich tree config (the SAME-NAME top-level `treeConfig` is the cross-renderer narrow subset; when both are set the generator merges them into tableOptions.treeConfig with the top-level key winning). Use `treeConfig.transform:true + rowField + parentField` to build a tree from FLAT rows; use the top-level `treeConfig` for nested `children` arrays on el-table / a-table.

children.description: @deprecated vxe v4 alias of childrenField; normalized at runtime.

lazy.description: Lazy-load children (vxe only; the loader function itself is a Tier-3 extension point and cannot travel in JSON).

mapChildren.description: Field that caches original children in transform mode (default '_X_ROW_CHILD').

parentField.description: Parent id field for transform mode (default 'parentId').

rowField.description: Row id field for transform mode (default 'id').

transform.description: Build the tree client-side from FLAT rows (needs rowField + parentField). vxe only.

validConfig.description: vxe cell validation feedback (pair with `rules` on the column's editRender). Advanced: only with engine:'vxe'.

autoPos.description: Scroll the first invalid cell into view.

msgMode.description: Show one message or the full message list (default 'single').

virtual.description: Enable virtual scrolling for large datasets. vue3 renders the el-table-v2 engine. antdv and vue2 have NO virtual scrolling: a-table never implemented it and Element UI has no el-table-v2 — both targets warn and render a plain table. For large data on antdv/vue2 use `engine: 'vxe'` instead.

target.description: Target renderer: vue3 (Element Plus), vue2 (Element UI), antdv (Ant Design Vue)

treeConfig.description: Declarative tree table — the SAME cross-renderer narrow subset as generate_crud's top-level `treeConfig` ({childrenField?, expandAll?}). Merged with tableOptions.treeConfig (this top-level key wins on conflicts). Distinct from the vxe-only `tableOptions.treeConfig`.

childrenField.description: Key name that holds a row's nested child nodes (default 'children'). Set only when the API nests children under a different key.

expandAll.description: Whether all nodes start expanded (default false).

name: generate_table
